# Session 0
Party located the landing spot of the capstone, found the others who located it first, and identified (broadly) two tablets relating to the purposes of its construction and a potential fix.

They can attempt to trace the path back to the "fire" tower and will find it inhabited by a band of bandits who have been looting relics and shipping them back to Marathas.

The bandits have transported one of the capstone halves already, its currently on its way out of Gwen, but the other is remaining behind until transport can be properly arranged.
- The capstone shipped first has been waylaid and would be able to be caught up to, were they to pursue. (the capstone keeps breaking shit and forcing them to pause, but its power wanes as they get further away from the Gate)

Some of the bandits are in pursuit of the group and want their tablets back as they were valuable relics, but have only really been able to keep eyes on Rory and Sebastien. They plan on jumping them once they can find them outside of town.

The tower is an ancient and archaic structure, long used as a fire tower by the barony for its positioning, but originally intended to map the stars in search of answers relating to the Entities. They found some, but much is now on the way to Marathas or other high bidders as the unimportant relics are pawned off.
- They will find baubles and such inside, most of which are unimportant but potentially valuable.
- They do find a few fragments of relics, but for the most part the structure is being simply used as an outpost. Their work here is done aside from the capstone and the examination of the mechanism which has been determined to be too large to move and will be left behind.
- Several bandits are still left behind, as well as one of the Marathan thaumaturgists. (who is out when they arrive)
- There are burnt shipping logs being fed to the fire when they show up. Most are already gone and for every round they spend not rescuing them, they lose another line. There are three lines.
	1. Three blackened soapstone shards from the Imperial Marathan scholars' gnomon seer. Sold; Lenz.
	2. Five potentially corresponding tubular clay tablets reassembled under the purview of gnomonic guidance. Sold; Lenz.
	3. One eastern half of the capstone of the Grand Gate of Posa, bearing his celestial insignia and an uncertainty of stability. Sold; Puradi.

Above them all is the ancient mechanism of the Marathan mages: a threefold rotating set of disks that was used to help map crucial locations and potential places for Gates to be built. It was used to "determine" the most optimal spots to put a gate relating to a particular Entity.
